summary: Frontend E2E of AR (Ventes & Clients) module. Verified nav popover, AR page tabs (invoices/customers/config), config actions (seed taxes, mapping save, FX rate save), customer create (QA Client, CHF, VAT_STD), and full maker-checker invoice happy path with two personas. persona_junior (maker) created + submitted 2 invoices; persona_finance (checker) approved + posted both (INV-2026-0002 with correct total 1081.00 CHF = 1000 + 8.1% VAT, INV-2026-0003 = 540.50 CHF), payment 1081 marks INV-2026-0002 Payée. Sensitive gating validated: junior's approve attempt was refused (status stayed Soumise = 403 denial), and post button is hidden for junior on submitted state. Partial credit note (100 net on line 0 of INV-2026-0003) was created + submitted by junior with success toast 'Note de crédit créée & soumise (à approuver)'. NOTE (UI gap): there is no credit-note list/approve UI in this build to complete the CN approval flow (not a blocker per request). All 9 tracked assertions PASS.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> as child of <option> in the periods <select> (data-ve instrumentation injects a span). Non-blocking but pollutes console.

ui_gaps.issue: No dedicated CN list / approve / post UI in this build; junior can create + auto-submit but checker cannot approve via UI. Reported as UI gap per instruction, not a run failure.

action_items: (Optional) Add a Credit Notes tab / approval controls to complete the maker-checker CN flow in the UI.
(Cosmetic) Suppress data-ve instrumentation on <option> children to avoid React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: SalesAR.js is clean (~235 lines) and uses data-testids consistently for every interactive element.

InvoiceRow correctly gates action buttons by status; Post/Approve buttons only appear in the state where the backend expects them, so junior visually never sees an unauthorized Post button (defense in depth).
Toasts surface backend errors via e.response?.data?.detail — good UX for 403 denials.
test_credentials: persona_junior@accslegro.com/persona123 (maker, no sensitive perms), persona_finance@accslegro.com/persona123 (checker, full AR sensitive perms). Company Meelora 965f0770-8cf2-4199-a99f-819ff270436a period fp_meelora_2026_01 open.
seed_data_creation: Created customer 'QA Client' (CHF, VAT_STD). Created invoices INV-2026-0001 (1081 Payée), INV-2026-0002 (1081 Payée), INV-2026-0003 (540.50 Comptabilisée). Recorded FX rate USD->CHF 0.9 on 2026-01-15. Seeded CH tax codes (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AR frontend fully validated end-to-end. If retesting, note the seed data above is now persisted for company Meelora (extra invoices/customer). The only meaningful gap identified is the missing Credit Note approve/post UI. React hydration warning about <span> child of <option> comes from a dev-time instrumentation overlay (data-ve-*), not from SalesAR code.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. UI gap for CN approval is a scope limitation acknowledged in the request.
